goal: Publish a trustworthy, fast and premium shared VII map experience that supports discovery and decision-making across every public world.

intent_model.literal_request: Research Airbnb and Booking maps, improve VII maps to their level or better, show prices across all worlds, publish, and add comprehensive QA.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Users can understand where relevant places are, compare real values, select a place and move between map and list without broken state or uncertainty on any device or language.
likely_rejections: A visually improved map still displays inconsistent or fabricated prices.
The map works only in vacation or only on desktop.
The map and list disagree after pan, zoom or a return navigation.
The candidate passes source tests but is not visibly verified in production.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory and test every public world that exposes a map, not one shared component in isolation.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Requires six-world adapter and destination evidence.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Show the same verified price used by the corresponding result card when one exists; never invent a price for a source without one.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Adds price provenance and missing-price fallback checks.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Adopt proven decision patterns such as clear value markers, clustering, active-card sync, explicit viewport refresh and mobile map/list control while preserving VII identity.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Adds competitor-pattern comparison and original branded implementation checks.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Publish only the exact candidate that passes release gates and verify it at the public URL.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Adds immutable release identity, rollback and live proof.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: Geographic comparison of places currently eligible for the user's search.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Which visible place best fits based on location, verified value and core metadata.
cognitive_flow.next_action: Select a marker or card, inspect the synchronized place summary, then open the place or return to the full list.
deferred_complexity: Full place detail, booking rules, package details and supplier contact are revealed after place selection.
preserved_depth: World filters, date and guest state, list sorting, selected place, back/reload behavior, error recovery and map attribution remain reachable.

natural_destination: Public VII search and discovery routes on vii.spaplus.co for vacation, events, spa, hourly rooms, attractions and trails in four locales.

facts.claim: VII already has a shared Leaflet map component with clustering, overlapping-marker expansion, map/list view controls and selected-place cards.
facts.evidence: app/components/listing-map.tsx in the active release checkout.

facts.claim: VII project truth requires the list, completions, map, counts and availability seal to use the same eligibility definition.
Public place-detail maps remain passive saved snapshots until explicit activation.
Current world adapters do not use one consistent price-marker model.
facts.evidence: ListingMap, DiscoveryMap and TrailMap adapters in app/components/listing-map.tsx.

assumptions.claim: Event result objects expose a trustworthy public price in at least some cases.
assumptions.validation: Trace the event adapter from accepted source data to the visible list card and compare real fixtures before rendering map price.

assumptions.claim: Discovery priceLabel values are display-safe and belong to the current result state.
assumptions.validation: Inspect source construction and add provenance tests for spa, hourly and attractions.

assumptions.claim: Trails do not have a verified comparable price source.
assumptions.validation: Inspect trail data and UI contracts; retain semantic route/group markers unless a real price is proven.

in_scope: Shared map shell, marker, cluster, selected-place card and list/map controls
Verified price display across every world whose accepted result has a real price
Explicit semantic fallback where no price exists
Viewport search, initial camera, pan, zoom, clustering, overlap handling and active selection
Desktop, mobile and short-height responsive behavior
Hebrew, English, Russian and French localization and direction
Loading, empty, error, image fallback and tile fallback states
Dedicated map QA, affected regression, publish, rollback identity and public verification
out_of_scope: Changing supplier prices, availability or source-of-truth ownership
Replacing the approved passive place-detail snapshot policy
Unrelated SEO, CMS or platform migration work
invariants: No price, availability, review or distance is invented.
Map, list and counts use the same accepted eligible result pool.
Current filters, dates, guests, sorting and clean URLs survive map/list transitions, reload and back.
Map attribution and licensed tile sources remain visible.
Place-detail live maps still load only after explicit user action.
Existing place links, phone, WhatsApp and booking actions keep their current destination and analytics semantics.
affected_family: shared listing map components and controls
Hebrew, English, Russian and French locales

requirements.statement: Every public world that has a map uses the shared premium map shell and controls.
A map marker shows a localized verified price when the same result has a real display price; otherwise it shows a semantic non-price marker.
requirements.source: User request plus VII price-truth rules.

requirements.statement: Map markers, list cards, visible counts and selected-place data stay synchronized through filter, pan, zoom and viewport-search changes.
Initial camera, clusters, overlapping markers, active marker and selected-place card remain usable for single, multiple and dense results.
requirements.source: Map experience skill and user quality target.

requirements.statement: The map/list experience works on desktop, 390px mobile and short-height screens without hidden controls, overflow or trapped scroll.
requirements.source: User quality target and accepted mobile standards.

requirements.statement: All map UI is correctly localized and directionally laid out in Hebrew, English, Russian and French.
The map has useful loading, empty, missing-image, tile-error and retry/fallback states.
Map/list view, marker selection and viewport refresh remain observable through existing analytics without collecting new personal data.
requirements.source: VII analytics and product evidence requirement.

requirements.statement: The exact verified candidate is published once with rollback identity and public production evidence.
Dedicated automated map QA covers all affected worlds, languages, viewports and interaction states and is wired into QQQAAA.
requirements.source: User request: עליה תשים בדיקות QA מכל הבחינות.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative results exist in each of the six worlds.
acceptance_checks.action: Open map view on desktop, mobile and short-height viewports.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The shared map shell, map/list controls and result count are visible and usable in every world.

acceptance_checks.setup: A result exposes a verified price for the active query.
acceptance_checks.action: Compare its list card and map marker.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Both display the same localized amount and qualifier.

acceptance_checks.setup: A result has no verified price.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The marker remains selectable with a semantic icon or value and displays no fabricated amount.

acceptance_checks.setup: A filtered map view has a selected place.
acceptance_checks.action: Pan, zoom, apply search-this-area, switch to list, reload and use back.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The intended filter/result state persists, counts match the eligible IDs, and map interactions are recorded once.

acceptance_checks.setup: Fixtures include one place, dense nearby places and identical coordinates.
acceptance_checks.action: Zoom, open clusters and select each place.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every place can be reached and the active marker and selected card always identify the same place.

acceptance_checks.setup: Map view is open on mobile and then viewport height or width changes.
acceptance_checks.action: Rotate/resize, close the selected card and return to list.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No primary control is hidden, safe areas remain clear, and page scrolling is restored.

acceptance_checks.action: Open the map, select a marker and use map controls.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Text, number formatting, direction and control placement are correct with no Hebrew leakage or clipping.

acceptance_checks.setup: Tile/image loading is unavailable or result data is empty.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The UI remains understandable, offers a useful fallback/retry, and never shows a broken image or blank trapped surface.

acceptance_checks.setup: All candidate gates pass and the prior deployment identity is recorded.
acceptance_checks.action: Publish the exact commit and verify production.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The public URL serves the candidate behavior and a known prior release remains the rollback target.

acceptance_checks.setup: The dedicated map suite is installed.
acceptance_checks.action: Run it directly and through QQQAAA.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The same world/locale/viewport matrix runs in both paths and any geometry, value or interaction failure blocks the release.

acceptance_checks.setup: A recoverable map resource failure occurred.
acceptance_checks.action: Use the provided retry or switch map style once.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: A successful retry restores the map without duplicating controls, events or selected state.

open_questions.question: Which non-vacation data fields are verified price sources rather than descriptive text?
open_questions.resolution: Trace each adapter to the accepted list-card source before implementation; unsupported fields fall back to non-price markers.

authorization_boundary: Source, test, deployment and public verification for the map project are authorized. Supplier truth, paid services, unrelated content and legal compliance claims remain outside scope.
